name: Matrix Opticare Smooth straight Shea Butter Professional Shampoo 200ml (Made in India)
description:
Matrix Opti Care Smooth Straight Shea Butter Professional Shampoo – 200ml
For Frizz Control | With Shea Butter | Made in India

Origin: India 🇮🇳

Key Benefits:

Specially formulated for dry, coarse, or chemically straightened hair

Provides intense conditioning & nourishment with Shea Butter

Smooths hair texture & effectively controls frizz

Leaves hair soft, shiny, and more manageable

Ideal for frizzy & dry hair types

How to Use:

Apply to wet hair and gently massage into the scalp & lengths

Work into a rich lather and rinse thoroughly

For best results, follow with Matrix Opti Care Conditioner

In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately

Customer-Friendly Note:
